question: Does the frozen cost-constrained RNN still use weakly admitted evidence for global inference, despite substantially lower connection modification?

design.inputs: Unmodified archived inputs/liu-8.npz, including original cues, evidence signs, p, stable z, schedule, queries and labels; no resampling or task regeneration.
design.training: None. Load all six archived final checkpoints, keep all parameters frozen. No coefficient selection, gain/temperature fitting, new decoder or item-count transport.
design.single_relation: Use the archived eight whole-relation removals, each deleting all four occurrences in both global inputs and local writes. Reconstruct G_minus_r = archived_combined_minus_r - local_margin_minus_r. The local trace is independent of the RNN; recompute it in the original sequential float32 order. This gives the same global function as global-only removal with local writes preserved.
design.weak_group: Participant-relation cells with original retention=false and trial_retention=0 at every occurrence. Global channel 34 is already zero; channel 37 contains p*d. Retained cells are not mixed into the primary single-weak endpoint.
design.joint_intervention: On every original trial with z=0 set the RNN evidence channel 37 equal to channel 34 (zero). Leave channel 37 unchanged for z=1. Preserve local_evidence and every other array/channel, all four neural steps, cues, original clock, and queries. Equivalent input transformation to the inherited isolated route, applied acutely without retraining.
design.readout: Use terminal global-only margins for functional attribution and global order. Also report complete output with the unchanged local correction for competence; G is the global readout pathway, not P in isolation.
design.references: Frozen isolated results remain historical working-model context, not a paired experimental arm. The old retained-bridge novelty diagnostic remains a different estimand.

metrics.direct: Both orientations of the removed unordered relation.
metrics.remote: Queries sharing neither item with the removed relation, inherited disjoint-remote definition; it includes learned and nonlearned queries and does not assert topological mediation.
metrics.nonlearned: Queries whose unordered relation is absent from the displayed support graph, fixed before all interventions.
metrics.single_effects: Per participant-relation, average query CE_removed-CE_intact, correct_probability_intact-correct_probability_removed, and abs(global_margin_removed-global_margin_intact) within each group; then average equally over that participant's weak relations. CE uses logaddexp(0,-sign*margin/0.25). No cost-normalized ratios or strong-versus-weak selectivity claim.
metrics.joint_effects: Same signed CE/probability and absolute-margin effects on global output, averaged within participant. Include all 77, including zero-weak participants with exact zero intervention effect.
metrics.structure: Intact and joint-deletion global antisymmetric Hodge field, gradient-energy fraction, fixed-all-77 Hodge order and intersubject Kendall tau. Order construction is inherited; no sampled choice, accuracy filter or non-correct-ranker filter.
metrics.competence: Intact and joint-deletion global and complete-output learned/nonlearned expected correct probabilities. Mark retained competence only if both lower 95% bounds exceed .5, and retained global coherence only if its lower bound exceeds .95. These are interpretability checks, not main-model admission.
metrics.secondary: Report all direct/remote/probability/margin endpoints and paired structural changes to interpret primary functional contributions. Do not reinterpret one favorable secondary endpoint as a passed original mechanism gate.

statistics.unit: One participant within one network; query orientations then relations averaged before inference. Networks never pooled. Shared and Cost always use identical participant cells and input-derived masks.
statistics.single_missing: A participant without any weak relation has undefined single-weak contribution. Exclude that fixed input-defined subset before a paired mean bootstrap and report every excluded ID. No outcome-based exclusion. No-weak participants remain in all joint and structural endpoints.
statistics.pairing: For scalar differences bootstrap participant-level Cost-minus-Shared values; for joint-minus-intact tau use identical all-77 bootstrap counts on each order matrix. Also report the Cost-minus-Shared difference of the two tau changes with the same counts.
statistics.undefined: No dropping undefined tau bootstrap draws; any undefined draw makes the interval undefined. Scalar nonfinite values allowed only for predeclared zero-weak cells; otherwise stop.
statistics.interpretation: Descriptive within-network intervals; no population claim over network initializations. No equivalence boundary is justified here: intervals containing zero mean unresolved difference, never equality or absence. No pooling, optional stopping or extra cohort.

decision.beneficial_weak_use: Positive lower bound of deletion-induced nonlearned global CE increase supports beneficial dependence under this input distribution. Positive absolute-margin influence alone establishes an effect, not its benefit.
decision.attenuation: Upper bound below zero for Cost-minus-Shared CE benefit supports attenuation on that endpoint; zero-crossing differences remain unresolved. A smaller effect does not by itself prove selective storage, information loss, or lower information capacity.
decision.joint_and_single: Small single effects alongside clear joint effects are consistent with redundant or nonlinear joint use; do not add single effects to predict the joint effect or declare a unique redundancy mechanism.
decision.organization: A decrease in joint-deletion all-subject tau with preserved competence and coherence supports an acute role of weak access in homogenization. It neither makes the intervened network an independently trained isolated model nor identifies how a learner acquires routing.
decision.stop: Integrity or reconstruction failure stops dependent analysis. Valid negative or heterogeneous results still complete all six mandatory cells. No new bridge panel, training, architecture, cost grid, precision/noise change or threshold rescue in this study.
decision.claim_boundary: Functional causal contribution to terminal readout of frozen networks, on an already project-exposed synthetic Liu cohort. Not a measurement of stored bits, absence of coding, a human confirmation, physiological cost or main-model promotion. Acute joint deletion may be outside the trained distribution.

execution.qualification: Before outcome analysis use synthetic non-Liu batches and an untrained seed 910005. Check both deletion masks including reversed pair orientations and a zero-weak subject, independent local reconstruction, local preservation, global-only versus two-route removal, and eager/compiled parity at H200. No trained model used for qualification.
execution.runtime: Inherited bounded CUDA, one CPU/BLAS/compiler thread, fullgraph/default, TF32 disabled and mix_order_reduction=false. Actual versions recorded; no version-number admission gate. Require qualification and archived-intact parity in the current runtime.
execution.integrity: Verify original parent study hashes and Git witnesses for the fixed inputs, six checkpoints, old raw margins, training metadata and parent contracts. Verify parameters unchanged after execution. Validate input-only manipulation and reconstructed local baseline against archived intact-minus-global margins in every cell.
execution.freeze: Commit protocol, qualified computation and tests first; then create and commit a source/input/model lock before any new contribution outcome. All six cells complete before paired reporting; failures are not overwritten. Frozen parent evidence remains unchanged.
execution.numerics: Reconstruction qualification tests include independent NumPy local keys and sums. During execution intact frozen replay is checked against archive. Single effects use archived intact margins; joint effects and their structure use same-run intact replay margins, preventing floating replay discrepancies from becoming intervention effects. Both baselines are archived. Reconstruct all eight removed global fields using local-only replay; no routine rerun of old eight RNN removals. Joint deletion requires one new support rollout per network; intact replay is its parity reference.
execution.closure: Archive sufficient per-relation/global/joint arrays, participant endpoint vectors, qualification and execution locks, all-six results and Chinese interpretation. Validate registry, affected checks and full engineering suite for the new runtime entry; scoped commit and push origin/dev.
